I had a serious problem with my Yorkshire Terrier who barked constantly at the neighbor's house. Paulo taught me the methodology, I applied it, and by the second day the problem was practically solved.

I am continuously doing what was taught, and whenever I have doubts, I turn to Paulo, and he always helps me, always attentive!

I highly recommend Paulo's dog training service! I'm a mother of twins and I have two bulldogs, and he helped us with their training before and after the babies were born. I was afraid to let the children interact with the pets for fear they might end up hurting them, but with all his calm and dedication, Paulo guided us towards a peaceful, happy, and safe coexistence. He is a very competent and qualified professional who loves dogs and knows what he's doing.

My puppy was cared for by Paulo and had an incredible adaptation with her canine sister, who initially rejected her. Thanks to his techniques, today we have a docile, friendly, and very sociable puppy! If I could, I would give this excellent professional a thousand stars! ⭐️✨🐾 …
Excellent work!
Paulo is a very competent and dedicated professional who is very responsible and caring towards the dogs! I recommend him without hesitation!

My family and I moved from a house to an apartment, with a boxer and a cat. It was a very difficult period, and it seemed like my dog's adaptation wouldn't happen.
There are many animals living in the building, and there are also many dogs in the surrounding area...
My dog ​​had a trauma, and I was afraid of being attacked by dogs on the street. My fear made me insecure, and my dog ​​started to become aggressive, thinking he was protecting me. So I started to be afraid to go out on the street with him. I almost gave up, and even thought about giving him away. My husband encouraged me to contact Mr. Paulo, who fortunately managed to show me that I had to overcome my fear, be firmer, taught me obedience techniques to apply on the street and at home, and explained about neutering. Today my beloved Baruk is a happier dog, as he is no longer tense and reactive when he goes out on the street. He even has some dog and human friends now.
Thank you so much for your help.
Excellent professional! Very knowledgeable and a knack for teaching. Answered all my questions. The work was top-notch!

Excellent service! The professional is extremely attentive, careful, and patient. He explains the entire process clearly, showing every detail and answering all questions. He demonstrates great knowledge and dedication to his work. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a serious and high-quality service.

When I needed someone trustworthy to train my puppy, Paulo demonstrated patience, availability, empathy, and a lot of experience! In less than 10 days we were already seeing results! I always recommend him!
I highly recommend...excellent professional.

My golden retriever, Fun, was a little boy full of traumas and triggers. I also suffer from PTSD and Panic Disorder. Once, two months after I rescued Fun, we were on the street and I had an absurd panic attack. Fun noticed and came to help me, giving me that hug that only a golden retriever can give, very calmly. That day I realized that Fun was the one who rescued me. After the incident, I contacted Dogcoach, and we started training Fun as an Emotional Support Dog. Fun became more perceptive of every detail, obedience, focus, and knows exactly when he has to perform the role of support dog and when he is free to be a normal dog. Dogcoach changed our lives for the better, a great professional! Today, Fun and I do everything together, he goes to work with me, therapy, doctors wherever I go, and he is better behaved than me.

Thank you Dogcoach! The best mentor in dog training, Amazon Bestseller!
Excellent trainer. Thank you so much for everything, Paulo, and congratulations on your service.

I trained my dog ​​and my cat to prepare them for the arrival of my macaw! Even from a distance, Paulo followed me via WhatsApp, explaining everything and helping adapt the house before she arrived. I was terrified that the cat would chase the macaw or that the dog would attack it, hahaha, but today I feel super relaxed and can leave them all together without fear!

André, thank you so much for your feedback! 🐾
It's always gratifying to know that our training methodology is making a difference in the relationship between dogs and their owners. We remain committed to teaching with technique, patience, and lots of love. …
